executiveSummary: Key developments include Apple's expansion of free iPhone satellite access, introduction of iPhone Handoff feature on T-Mobile, and upcoming iOS 27 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 updates.

takeaways.title: AI-powered feature expansion
takeaways.description: Apple is expanding its AI-powered features, including Siri Recap, Live Rewind, and Apple Health app redesign, with new updates in iOS 27 and Apple Watch Ultra 4, as mentioned in articles 4, 10, and 26.

takeaways.title: Foldable smartphone market growth
takeaways.description: The iPhone Duo is expected to capture 24.8% of the foldable smartphone market in 2026, according to a TrendForce report, mentioned in article 19.

takeaways.title: T-Mobile's new iPhone Handoff feature
takeaways.description: T-Mobile will charge $5 per month for the new iPhone Handoff feature, mentioned in articles 3 and 7.

worthWatching: Apple's expansion of free iPhone satellite access could impact future satellite-based services
The growth of the foldable smartphone market may lead to increased competition
engineeringPerspective: The use of AI-powered features in Apple's products will require significant updates to existing codebases and may require new engineering approaches.
The introduction of the iPhone Duo and other foldable smartphones may require the development of new hardware designs and software architectures.
